t.7664-38-2.agn: The classification is for the concentrated solution (Skin Corr. 1B); in a diluted product the statement on the label depends on the concentration. In food it is E338.
t.7664-38-2.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 015-011-00-6 (CLP00): Skin Corr. 1B.
t.7664-38-2.summary: The acid of phosphorus; also used in food as an acidity regulator.
